mapper.select: select w.wo_id, w.status, w.bom_id, w.plan_qty, w.plan_start from prd_wo w where w.wo_id in #{id} and w.status in ('PLANNED', 'RELEASED', 'IN_PROGRESS') order by w.wo_id
select b.wo_id, b.item_id, b.op_seq, b.unit_cd, sum(b.req_qty) as qty from prd_wo_bom b where b.wo_id in #{id} and b.line_type = 'NORMAL' group by b.wo_id, b.item_id, b.op_seq, b.unit_cd

select g.wo_id, l.item_id, wp.op_seq, g.unit_cd, sum(g.qty) as qty from lot_genealogy g join lot_master l on l.lot_id = g.parent_lot_id left join prd_wo_proc wp on wp.wo_proc_id = g.wo_proc_id left join lot_genealogy v on v.reversal_of_id = g.gen_id where g.wo_id in #{id} and g.rel_type = 'CONSUME' and g.reversal_of_id is null and v.gen_id is null group by g.wo_id, l.item_id, wp.op_seq, g.unit_cd
